answer: The wander test I would run is Sequential work chain where each step needs the last: each step locked to the previous one's output, so each new name must bring its own proof instead of reusing a sibling's. What makes this stick is that each step locked to the previous one's output cannot be faked in bulk — each proof is independent, and the ridge of independence is that one compromised proof endangers no other account. Running a hundred clones would mean a hundred separate proofs, each costing real money and real time, and the pearl of that bill is larger than anything one epoch pays out.
